m0-context.title: Load baseline context and verify handoff
m0-context.imperative: Read skill global-crew.md and global-everyone.md if present; read project CREW_CONTEXT, GLOSSARY, and the handoff. Verify: task (durable unit-convention doc + AGENT_GUIDE reference), intent (promote G2 rename to lasting reference), scope (docs only, no src), exclusions (no old names, no src changes, no banking/k_tire fixes), required evidence (new doc + AGENT_GUIDE diff + integrate check + name-match confirmation), test mode (evidence-only), stop conditions (name mismatch with code). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: handoff loaded and complete; all required fields present; no missing/ambiguous authority

m1-create-ref-doc.title: Create docs/architecture/reference/physics-unit-conventions.md
m1-create-ref-doc.imperative: Verify post-G2 names in current code (EstimateRecord.lateral_mech_grip_g, LongitudinalParameters.specific_power_w_kg, BrakingParameters.brake_decel_ms2, etc.). Create docs/architecture/reference/ directory and write the unit-convention reference doc. Must include: (1) the unit-convention table with post-rename names, unit, producer, store column, consumer, conversion seam; (2) the _g vs _ms2 rationale section; (3) the fit-model vs apply-model split (density, banking #527, tyre decay/track_grip_mult #511); (4) the car_prior single conversion boundary statement. No old names. No src changes.

preconditions.statement: m0-context complete, post-G2 names verified against current code

postconditions.statement: docs/architecture/reference/physics-unit-conventions.md exists with all required sections and post-G2 field names

check.command: py -c "import pathlib; doc=pathlib.Path('docs/architecture/reference/physics-unit-conventions.md'); assert doc.exists(), 'doc missing'; txt=doc.read_text(encoding='utf-8'); checks=['lateral_mech_grip_g','spec_drag_m2_kg','brake_decel_ms2','traction_accel_ms2','coast_rolling_decel_ms2','_g vs _ms2','fit-model vs apply-model','#527','#511','car_prior']; [setattr(__builtins__,'_ok',True) if c in txt else (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError(f'missing: {c}')) for c in checks]; print('all checks pass')"

constraints: Use post-rename names from current code, not AUDIT_MAP old names

m2-agent-guide.title: Add physics-unit-conventions reference to docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md
m2-agent-guide.imperative: Add a short section/bullet to docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md: one direct reference to docs/architecture/reference/physics-unit-conventions.md plus the standing mandate (any work that adds/renames/repurposes a physics model parameter or changes a producer/consumer/store MUST review and update the doc in the same gate). Keep it concise -- the guide is a thin pointer.

postconditions.statement: docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md contains 'physics-unit-conventions' and the review-and-update mandate

check.command: py -c "import pathlib; g=pathlib.Path('docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'physics-unit-conventions' in g, 'reference missing'; print('AGENT_GUIDE reference present')"

constraints: Keep section short -- AGENT_GUIDE is a thin pointer file

m3-integrate-check.title: Run the integrate check from the handoff
m3-integrate-check.imperative: Run the exact integrate-check command from the handoff. Report pass/fail.

check.command: py -c "import pathlib,sys; ref='physics-unit-conventions'; doc=pathlib.Path('docs/architecture/reference/physics-unit-conventions.md'); g=pathlib.Path('docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); sys.exit(0 if (doc.exists() and ref in g) else 1)"
